prompt:
TITLE:
Baby’s Actual View While Nursing

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Japanese family lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin and fabric texture.

SUBJECT:
20-year-old adult Japanese mother.
Natural dark brown hair.
Dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy natural skin.

BODY:
Natural feminine adult figure.
Realistic anatomy.

OUTFIT:
Simple loose light-colored home top, naturally positioned for nursing.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Bright contemporary Japanese living room.
The mother is sitting comfortably on a sofa and actively nursing her three-month-old baby.
This is the middle of feeding, not before or after nursing.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Relaxed natural maternal posture.
She looks downward toward her baby.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Strict first-person vision through the nursing baby's eyes.
The camera physically replaces the baby's eyes during active nursing.
Reconstruct only what the baby can actually see from that exact position.
The viewpoint is extremely close to the mother's body.
The immediate nursing area naturally dominates the near field of vision.
Her adjusted clothing surrounds and overlaps the near foreground with realistic folds, edges, gaps, contact shadows, and occlusion.
Do not move the camera backward to make a conventional portrait.
Do not arrange the mother neatly inside the frame.
Because the baby's eyes are extremely close to the mother, much of the scene is naturally cropped and partially obscured.
Only whatever portion of the mother's neck, chin, mouth, nose, or face would genuinely be visible from this position should appear near the upper or peripheral part of the frame.
The mother's complete face does not need to be visible.
The baby itself is not visible.

LIGHTING:
Soft natural window light.

DETAILS:
Physically accurate infant-eye perspective during active nursing.
Extremely short viewing distance.
Realistic overlapping anatomy and clothing.
Natural skin contours, fabric contact, depth, shadows, and occlusion.
Candid and imperfect framing.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
Not preparing to nurse.
Not adjusting clothing before nursing.
Not a portrait.
No third-person perspective.
No visible baby.
No external photographer viewpoint.
No centered face.
No artificially unobstructed view.
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
